# airlock_domain_groups (Data Source)

Read domain security groups known to Airlock.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "airlock_domain_groups" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `items_json` (String, Sensitive) JSON response returned by Airlock. Marked sensitive because administrative data may include environment details.
